name: Beardd's Wayfarer: quest waypoint
author: Beardd (BearddOddity)
description: A diamond in the view over the place the compass marks - the tracked quest, or a pin, destination, exit or region-map waypoint, each in its own colour and word - with the distance, and an arrow at the screen's edge when it is off to a side. The compass's diamond takes the same colour. F7 on/off, Shift+F3 its look.
